entry.title: How we saved 100 terabytes of memory by optimizing 1.1.1.1’s DNS cache
entry.quote: Five successive changes to how cache entries are stored in memory cut the per-entry footprint by over 50%. Across our fleet, these changes freed up roughly 100 terabytes of memory, equivalent to the amount of RAM in 130 of our Gen 13 servers.
